headline: Chile's Indisa agrees to sell Bionet laboratory stake to Achs for $18.9B CLP
summary: Clínica Indisa signed a share purchase agreement to sell its participation in clinical laboratory chain Bionet to Asociación Chilena de Seguridad (Achs) for 457,668 UF (approximately 18.93 billion pesos), pending regulatory approval.
why: Healthcare consolidation in Chile reshapes provider networks and occupational health services across private medical groups.

impacts.name: Clínica Indisa
impacts.why: Monetizes diagnostic laboratory holding, generating 18.9 billion pesos upon regulatory clearance.
